title: Arabic-first web shell and design-system foundation
objective: Create a runnable Arabic-first Next.js App Router shell and reusable visual foundation for EstateFlow without introducing domain workflows or server coupling.

context.product: Arabic-first, demo-first real-estate operations platform using synthetic data only.
context.visual_direction: Calm operational cockpit informed by property files, contracts, and maps. Light neutral canvas, deep navy for trust, restrained teal for operational movement, and gold reserved for meaningful financial/deal milestones.

requirements: Use a locale-aware Next.js App Router shell with Arabic as the initial supported locale and document direction/lang semantics.
Create a design-tokens package with semantic color, spacing, radius, typography, and status tokens; consume its values in the web shell rather than defining an unrelated palette per component.
Build responsive Arabic navigation and application shell usable from 360px through desktop.
Create a static design-system demo route covering typography, controls, table, finance values, semantic statuses, empty state, loading state, error state, and not-found state.
Add global focus-visible styling, reduced-motion handling, semantic landmark/navigation structure, and accessible labels for icon-only controls.
Use synthetic static content only and make it clear that the screen is a foundation/demo, not a live workflow.
Use Next production build for apps/web build verification.
Capture desktop and mobile Arabic visual evidence from a running local web server.
acceptance: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm test:integration, pnpm build, and pnpm format:check pass.
Arabic shell renders on /ar with lang=ar and dir=rtl; a missing route renders the custom Arabic not-found experience.
Desktop and 360px screenshots demonstrate navigation, readable content, and no horizontal viewport overflow.
No browser code imports API server, Prisma, environment secrets, database access, or business-domain models.
Scope checksum audit identifies no paths outside this packet.
forbidden: No API endpoint, database schema, Prisma migration, authentication, authorization, or browser-to-database access.
No real customer data, credentials, provider integration, deployment, public exposure, commit, or push.
No arbitrary component library or design-template dependency.
No edits under apps/api, apps/worker, infra, or unrelated packages.
verification_plan: Start with token package regression tests.
Run package and root quality gates.
Run Next locally on loopback only and inspect Arabic desktop/mobile and missing-route rendering with browser automation.
Compare final workspace paths against pre-execution checksum and document evidence.
